{{Top|leg}}
'''Photovoltaic light panels''' were illumination devices. They absorbed [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] throughout the [[Standard day/Legends|day]], then released the stored energy once night fell, creating a brilliant illumination. The [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] was constructed of photovoltaic light panels.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
